name: siyuan-mcp-server
description: Connect Claude to your SiYuan Note workspace with 53 specialized tools
long_description: Enable AI-powered note management with SiYuan Note. Features 47 atomic tools for fine-grained control and 6 composite tools for optimized workflows including workspace navigation, task management, daily notes automation, and intelligent search. Includes reference tools with SQL examples, chart patterns, template guides, and search strategies. Supports notebook management, document operations, block control, file management, SQL queries, attributes, exports, templates, and system functions.

siyuan_url.title: SiYuan API URL
siyuan_url.description: The URL where your SiYuan Note instance is running (e.g., http://localhost:6806 for local, http://192.168.1.100:6806 for network)

siyuan_token.title: SiYuan API Token
siyuan_token.description: Your SiYuan API token (found in SiYuan Settings → About). This is securely stored and never exposed.

tools.name: siyuan_listNotebooks
tools.description: List all notebooks in SiYuan workspace

tools.name: siyuan_getContentTree
tools.description: Get complete workspace hierarchy with content previews (composite tool)

tools.name: siyuan_getDocumentOutline
tools.description: Get detailed document structure and outline (composite tool)

tools.name: siyuan_searchWithContext
tools.description: Search content with surrounding context blocks (composite tool)

tools.name: siyuan_getRecentContent
tools.description: Get recently modified documents and blocks (composite tool)

tools.name: siyuan_getOrCreateDailyNote
tools.description: Get or create today's daily note (composite tool)

tools.name: siyuan_findTasks
tools.description: Find and manage TODO items across workspace (composite tool)

tools.name: siyuan_createDocWithMd
tools.description: Create a new document with Markdown content

tools.name: siyuan_sql
tools.description: Execute SQL query on SiYuan database

tools.name: siyuan_uploadAsset
tools.description: Upload images, PDFs, and other files to workspace

tools.name: siyuan_getSQLExamples
tools.description: Get common SQL query examples for the SiYuan database

tools.name: siyuan_getChartExamples
tools.description: Get examples for creating charts and visualizations (Mermaid, ECharts, PlantUML)

tools.name: siyuan_getTemplateExamples

tools.name: siyuan_getSearchPatterns
tools.description: Get advanced search patterns and techniques for finding content
